plugins.name: claude-dev-tools
plugins.description: Various helper tools for Claude Code development

plugins.name: agent-sessions
plugins.description: Find, search, and resume Claude Code and Codex agent sessions after a terminal or multiplexer dies. Reads the on-disk JSONL transcripts, matches them against live processes, and prints copy-paste resume commands.

plugins.name: pastila
plugins.description: Create encrypted, shareable links using pastila.nl - an end-to-end encrypted pastebin by ClickHouse

plugins.name: obsidian-helper
plugins.description: Session notes and task tracking in the Obsidian work vault

plugins.name: cli-dev
plugins.description: Skills for designing and reviewing agent-friendly CLI tools

plugins.name: gist
plugins.description: Guidelines for using GitHub Gists as an internal pastebin. Covers conventions for creating, sharing, and consuming gists via gh CLI.

plugins.name: prompts
plugins.description: Reusable starter prompts as skills (pr-review, ticket-kickoff) — encode the boilerplate you'd otherwise paste at the start of every session.

plugins.name: reference-docs
plugins.description: Reference books and docs as skills — each skill embeds a section map of an LLM-published text (llms.txt style) and fetches only the sections relevant to the conversation. Currently: Inference Engineering (Baseten Books, 2026).

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior-dev mode — forces the simplest solution that works (YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions). Adds the /ponytail intensity toggle plus /ponytail-review, /ponytail-audit, /ponytail-debt. Pinned to v4.5.0; sourced from DietrichGebert/ponytail (MIT).
